faq.title: Frequently Asked
faq.description: Find answers to the most common questions about our training and nutrition programs

q1.question: How long does it take to see results?
q1.answer: Most clients start seeing noticeable results within 4-6 weeks of consistent commitment. However, this varies based on starting point, goals, and adherence to training and nutrition programs.

q2.question: Do I need special equipment?
q2.answer: While results can be optimized with gym equipment, we can create effective home workout programs with limited equipment. We customize each program based on what you have available.

q3.question: What if I have dietary restrictions?
q3.answer: We design all nutrition plans according to your dietary preferences, sensitivities, and restrictions. Whether you're vegetarian, halal, or have specific sensitivities, we'll create a plan that works for you.

q4.question: How often will I communicate with the coach?
q4.answer: This depends on your chosen plan. Basic includes weekly check-ins, Premium includes daily check-ins, and Elite includes 24/7 support via WhatsApp.

q5.question: Can I switch plans later?
q5.answer: Absolutely! You can upgrade or downgrade at any time. We'll help you find the right plan for your current goals and needs.

q6.question: What are the benefits of cupping sessions?
q6.answer: Cupping improves blood circulation, relieves muscle pain, helps with detoxification, and speeds up recovery. It's excellent for athletes and trainees.
